description: As a forensic analyst, carve_from_bytes runs post-carve anti-forensic detection so that record ID gaps and file header inconsistencies are surfaced automatically
steps: carve_from_bytes on data with two chunks where record IDs are non-contiguous populates result.anti_forensic with at least one RecordIdGap indicator
carve_from_bytes on data with a corrupt chunk checksum populates the chunk's anti_forensic field with ChunkChecksumMismatch
carve_from_bytes on data with a file header where NextRecordId is lower than the highest recovered record ID populates result.anti_forensic with NextRecordIdInconsistency
carve_from_bytes on clean data with no gaps and valid checksums returns empty result.anti_forensic and empty per-chunk anti_forensic
